title: Agent Web QA Auditor input
description: Acceptance-check up to 25 public HTTP(S) pages. Private networks, credentials, and authenticated pages are intentionally unsupported.

url.title: Single public page URL
url.description: A public HTTP or HTTPS URL to audit. You can use this field, the URLs list, or both.

urls.title: Public page URLs
urls.description: Optional batch of up to 25 public HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

acceptanceThreshold.title: Minimum passing score
acceptanceThreshold.description: A page passes only when its HTTP response is successful and its deterministic QA score reaches this value.

maxLinks.title: Maximum same-origin links to check
maxLinks.description: Set to 0 to skip link checks.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per request
timeoutSecs.description: Maximum duration for each page or link request.
